question: The customer has no GSTIN on file. Does that stop me raising the invoice?
note: GSTIN, PAN and TAN are non-mandatory everywhere in this product and must block nothing. It has drifted back into the code more than once, so it is worth a case that fails loudly the moment the assistant starts telling people otherwise - a wrong answer here stops an invoice going out. The definition is not written here: `must_define` names the shipped term file, so editing glossary_terms/gstin.md changes what this case measures, and deleting it or narrowing its aliases turns the build red on the push that does it.
